whatsNewResearchTitle: Notebook training, LaTeX papers, and Agent quotas in one place.
whatsNewResearchBody: Connect Google Colab GPUs or Jupyter in Notebook, write and compile LaTeX papers in Work, and track subscription quotas and Agent usage clearly.
whatsNewResearchNotebookBody: Run cells on cloud GPUs or Jupyter, and monitor multi-account training metrics, VRAM, and CU spend.
whatsNewResearchLatexBody: Edit source beside PDF with SyncTeX navigation and citation completion; review AI edits before compiling.
whatsNewResearchQuotaBody: Antigravity now runs over ACP, with shared quota pools, Devin subscription quotas, and per-Agent usage.
whatsNewResearchStableBody: Fixes for external Agent approvals, ACP tool recovery, and cross-platform stability
whatsNewEverydayTitle: To-dos, mini-apps, and phone link — your whole day, connected.
whatsNewEverydayBody: Plan the day in local Markdown notes and hand tasks to Kun; install interactive widgets as desktop apps; link a phone without signing in and keep Code, Work, and remote control in your pocket.
whatsNewEverydayDailyBody: Day-by-day local Markdown with page, quadrant, and calendar views; hand a to-do to Kun or start a session right from it.
whatsNewEverydayWidgetsBody: Generated tools become standalone desktop apps in one click, with a launcher entry, preserved local state, and updates from chat revisions.
whatsNewEverydayPhoneBody: A one-time pairing code links your phone over an encrypted direct connection shared by Code, Work, and remote desktop — chats and attachments never pass through a relay.
whatsNewEverydayStableBody: Remote pairing, data migration, and desktop pet stability improvements
whatsNewWorkbenchTitle: Bring ideas to life, with less friction.
whatsNewWorkbenchBody: From sources and designs to finished work, everything connects more smoothly.
whatsNewWorkbenchWorkBody: Open sessions beside files and keep papers in one dedicated space.
whatsNewWorkbenchDesignBody: Explore pages, states, and alternatives on the same canvas.
whatsNewWorkbenchReportBody: See charts in conversations, then save and update your reports.
whatsNewWorkbenchStableBody: More reliable recovery, collaboration, and everyday work
whatsNewMissingTitle: The notes can wait. Your work can continue.
whatsNewMissingReady: Kun is updated and ready to use
whatsNewMissingBody: The summary for this version isn't available here. The full notes are in the changelog.
whatsNewHint: Reopen these notes anytime in Settings › Version & updates.
whatsNewSettingDesc: Reopen the release summary shown the first time Kun starts after an update.
whatsNewFocusTitle: Hide the Kun logo and account card
whatsNewFocusBody: Turn it on and the swimming Kun logo, the sidebar account card, conversation avatars and Kun animations step aside, leaving just the conversation.
whatsNewFocusWhere: Switch it anytime with Focus at the bottom of the sidebar
whatsNewArtifactsTitle: Everything Kun makes, in one place
whatsNewArtifactsBody: Design drafts, documents, slides, spreadsheets, whiteboards and generated images, sorted by project and type. Open one to preview it, or ask Kun to revise it in its conversation.
whatsNewArtifactsWhere: Find it anytime under Artifacts in the sidebar
